title: HighTide
description: A modpack based around the RPG skills, and as you progress you get skills and choose ur own path to get more powerful, but something is slowly taking over your body as you grow fur.
body:
A survival transformation experience inspired by Changed, rebuilt for stability, immersion, and multiplayer play.

High Tides drops you into a world where survival isn’t just about hunger and mobs — it’s about adaptation. Strange creatures roam the land, transformations change how you move, fight, and survive, and the environment itself feels alive and dangerous.

RPG Create Adventure (Fabric 1.20.1)

RPG Create Adventure is a Fabric 1.20.1 modpack focused on RPG progression, combat improvements, magic systems, world exploration, and technical automation.

The pack combines RPG-style combat and spellcasting with new biomes, improved world generation, and the mechanical systems from Create. Performance and quality-of-life improvements are also included to help the pack run smoothly.

This pack is designed for single-player or small multiplayer servers and aims to expand vanilla gameplay without completely replacing it.

Main Features
RPG Combat and Progression

The pack introduces skill progression, weapons, and spellcasting systems.

Included systems and mods:

Spell Engine

Simply Skills

Simply Swords

Better Combat

Wizards (RPG Series)

Elemental Wizards (More RPG Classes)

These systems add spells, skill trees, new weapons, and additional character progression mechanics.

Exploration and World Generation

The world is expanded with new biomes and structures to explore.

Major world mods include:

Biomes O' Plenty

BetterNether

End Remastered

These mods add new environments, blocks, and exploration content across all dimensions.

Automation and Technology

The pack includes mechanical automation through the Create ecosystem.

Main tech mods:

Create

Create Crafts & Additions

Create: Structures

These mods allow players to build mechanical systems, automation setups, and factories using rotational power.

Performance Improvements

Several optimization mods are included to improve performance and reduce memory usage.

Examples include:

Sodium

ModernFix

FerriteCore

ImmediatelyFast

LazyDFU

Quality of Life

The pack also includes multiple interface and gameplay improvements:

Just Enough Items (JEI)

Jade

Xaero's Minimap

AppleSkin

Tom's Simple Storage Mod

These mods improve usability by adding recipe viewing, tooltips, minimaps, and better storage systems.

Graphics and Visual Improvements

Optional shader and visual enhancements are supported with:

Iris Shaders

Wavey Capes

Falling Leaves

Eating Animation

Not Enough Animations

Shaders are optional but supported.

Included Libraries

The pack also includes required libraries such as:

Fabric API

Architectury API

Cloth Config

Trinkets

BCLib

TerraBlender

These are required dependencies for other mods in the pack.

Minecraft Version

Minecraft: 1.20.1
Loader: Fabric
Server Compatible: ✅ Yes
